notes.title: This game is being removed
notes.content:
We no longer support the development of this title and the servers are no longer active. Also, due to the lack of interest, activity and support, we are removing this title from the Steam store. For those who did show support for this game we thank you. 

We will be focusing on other titles of interest as we can only devote our time and resources on the games that players want to play. Unfortunately, inactive games are simply used to farm cards and for collection purposes. We are a company that take pride in our games and community of players so we are focusing on encouraging only the titles that players see value in actually playing. 

I do thank you all for your support over the years.

notes.title: Welcome to 2017... a word from the developer
notes.content:
2 more of our games have been greenlit thanks to the support of the steam community. As lead developer for all of our games, I would like to extend a sincere thank you to the steam community as a whole for showing your support for our games once again. We owe you all everything as we are a very small team of only 2 people and rely greatly on the support of every player.

We aren't perfect but we are a dedicated and hard working team that has learned a lot since we've gotten our first game on steam. We are working harder than ever to meet your expectations and hope we can continue to make the games you all want to play. We appreciate your support and patience with us as we make strides to bring you the best games at an affordable price. 

We are looking forward to a great year. Making games is what we love to do, and making the games that you want to play is the only reason why we are still doing this. Your support means the world to us, not to sound sentimental but, you are all the reason why we do what we do.

I want to wish all of you a Happy, a Blessed and Prosperous 2017.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: 3rd Party Steam Key Time Limit Removed
notes.content:
After speaking with some players very unpleased about the time limit for 3rd party bundled steam keys, we decided to remove the time limit after all. You all deserve better and I appreciate your support and words of encouragement. You could have gotten angry with us (deservingly) but you kept your cool, contacted us and gave your opinions. 

Business as usual, all keys purchased in the past and future will NOT have a limit on them. The only keys that will have a limit on them are the free access keys for Fasaria World Online which will stop in July.

Please, always reach out to us when there is something you don't like or agree with, we are always open to listen.

notes.title: About Bundle Keys and Free Access Keys
notes.content:
We will be locking all keys that were purchased in bundles from any 3rd party website 1 month after the bundle is over. This should give more than enough time for people who purchased the bundle enough time to activate their game. After that time, we will NOT re-issue any steam keys so make sure you activate your keys within the month you receive the bundle. For those who may have gotten the keys as a gift or sold on a trade website, chances are they will no longer work if the time has expired.

We will be stopping the free access key offer to "Fasaria World Online" for "Angels of Fasaria 2.0" and "AoF World Online" by July 1st. If you have the game and would like to claim your key, now is the time. Once the offer is closed, it won't be available again.

[B]About Hate Free Heroes:[/B]

Hate Free Heroes is a modern day role playing game that takes the player into the role of an H.F.H agent and researcher dedicated to decreasing the rise of "Aggromites" in the city.
 
Aggromites/Aggromite (definition) [ag-roh-myht] [noun]: A mischievous entity that influence a person's aggression levels through the "dream world" or altered reality.
 
Join the H.F.H agency, complete major missions and research missions to help the agency discover the reason behind the growing rise in "Aggro". Journey through the city of Newsport to find faithful agents that will join your cause as you begin to unravel the mystery behind the "Aggromite" influx.

• Upgradeable Gear with Gear Slots

notes.title: February Newsletter: A Lot of Updates Coming!
notes.content:
We have a lot of major updates on the way for all of our games so keep a look out.

[h1][b]Fasaria World Online:[/b][/h1]

A lot of major changes to the game and a major overhaul of some features are in the works, expect to see a full update to the game very soon.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria RPG:[/b][/h1]

We are working on a new version of Angels of Fasaria RPG from the ground up. This new version will be released as a stand alone game and it is TOTALLY different in comparison from the current version. A lot of major changes and improvements will be included to this newer version so it will be sold as a new game. We are still considering creating a browser based mmo to accompany that version but no absolute decision has been made yet.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria Online:[/b][/h1]

We still have sign ups open for alpha testing for the online game version of Angels of Fasaria. Not a lot of people have signed up or shown interest so development is currently halted. If you want to see the online game be made, sign up and show your support for it. Currently, you can sign up on steam but private testing may occur which will require an NDA and participation will be outside of steam until the game is ready for beta testing.

[h1][b]AoF Chess Club 2.0:[/b][/h1]

Some nice updates are scheduled for AoF Chess Club 2.0, mainly the translated versions which should open the community to players from around the world. More info soon.

[h1][b]AoF World Online:[/b][/h1]

We have a community edition in the works which will include the server with scripts for all players to be able to launch and play locally on their computer. We will also open up the workshop giving players freedom to edit and submit their modified versions. This should open this game to the community for further development and growth as we are no longer developing this game.

The partner dlc will allow players to host their own server where trial players will have access to play on for free. Active servers will have the opportunity to migrate to our list of servers reserved for paid players.

notes.title: Resource Gain and New Resource Report Added
notes.content:
We updated the resource multiplier to distribute more resources per tick. This should greatly improve resources earned from production. We also added a news alert that will send all players a report of their resources earned and from how it is being distributed (from buildings/workers etc) each tick (15 minutes).

This update should make it a lot easier for players to manage resources and production. Players will now know what is producing resources and by how much every tick. With 
the new resource multiplier, players will earn a considerable amount of income now. This update will make your building and worker production a lot more worth the effort.

Your Research level also plays a significant part in how much buildings and workers produce each turn. As your research level increases so will your over all production.

notes.title: NSE Circuit: December Newsletter
notes.content:
You can find our full newsletter at NSE Circuit.

http://nsecircuit.com/news/dec15newsletter/

We have a lot of great news to announce for December! First off we would like to wish everyone a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year! We are looking forward to a new a productive year in 2016. Looking back, we've gotten all 4 games greenlit and published on steam in less than 1 year! That is amazing and could only have been accomplished with your continued support. We are going to continue to work hard to meet your demands and your expectations of us, and we are incredibly thrilled and appreciative of your continued support for our games.
 
New NSE Circuit Launcher:
 
We've updated our launcher for Fasaria World Online and AoF Chess Club with a new one that should correct a lot of issues players encountered before, it is also updated with a snazzy look and feel so enjoy and post your input and opinions on the changes.
 
New Website & Shop:
 
We've updated our website with a new design and our community has been updated with better functions and community features for easier navigation. We will also be having monthly give aways and discount coupons exclusive to registered members so look out for those as well.
 
Trial Access & Demos:
 
We will be announcing our trial and demo access for each game in 2016. This should be an interesting way to allow players to experience our games and community while also inviting friends and other players to do the same. More info about our upcoming demos soon.
 
AoF World Online Private Servers:
 
We are considering providing an opportunity for players to host their own private servers while also being able to build their following of players from our community. All players who download the trial version will only have access to play on the private servers but for free. This will make it easy for those who own the private servers to invite players while getting new ones right from our community. If we do decide to do this, we will also offer community opportunities to help private server owners to build their network as well. We will also open up our workshop on steam where developers can modify the server scripts and share it or sell to other players. If this is an idea you support, please vote by posting in our discussion board thread below "I support this idea".
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100218
 
Fasaria World Online New Update:
 
We are working hard on a new expanded version of the game (no cost to current players) that will offer more levels, areas, gear to buy and a lot of other cool features. We have a lot planned for 2016 for updates and community growth. Look for the expanded version later this month.
 
Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Online Game and Future:
 
We are still working on the outline and plans for the online game which will require more time, planning and community building. We want to be sure this game does well when we put it forth in 2017. We are still looking for players who own the game to volunteer for alpha testing which we plan should start early next year. We will be heavily involved with the community and their input for the online game's development. So far we have Angels of Fasaria in the works for a re-make for the RPG and the online game is looking like it will be bundled with the game. Players who sign up and get active in testing will be guaranteed free copies of both. Those who  already have a copy of Angels of Fasaria 2.0 will only have an opportunity to claim a copy of the online game.
 
Please sign up for alpha testing in the thread below:
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100219
 
Showing Your Support for the Community:
 
We will be working hard from now on in building the community and it's involvement. We don't believe showing support is as simple as posting a review or by just receiving public approval as we have seen that such can never genuinely express the heart of it's community. The support will come only with your voice, your input, your ideas and your participation within the community. Such are vital to us as a company and to the future of the community you've helped to build. If you support our company and want to see more come out of our games, join the community on NSE Circuit and contribute your thoughts and ideas and encourage others to do the same. We will be working very closely with our players from now on to build a reliable, cohesive, friendly and active community. With every newsletter from now on, we will open a discussion for your thoughts starting now. Please post your thoughts, opinions, suggestions or ideas concerning this last newsletter in this thread.
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100220

notes.title: BONUS: 50 Crystonian Crystals Each Month!
notes.content:
Players can now receive a bonus pack each month of 50 Crystonian Crystals. The 1st of every month, 50 crystals will be deposited into your player account that you can spend in the VIP shop. 

*Crystals can be earned through achievements and through the monthly bonus pack but can no longer be purchased through our online shop. If you become an ELITE Sponsor, 
you can earn more crystals each month and will receive a bonus amount of crystals with your order. The ELITE Sponsor package can only be purchased once per account and does not stack.

notes.title: Purchasing Crystals Removed from Shop
notes.content:
We removed your ability to buy crystonian crystals with money from our shop. We want to have our game focus on a "one time payment" model only. 

We have an opportunity for players to purchase a one time ELITE Sponsorship Package which will give you 150 crystals upon purchase and 100 more crystals every month in addition to the 50 crystals all players will now receive for free each month as well. (If you purchased crystals from us before now, you are eligible for the free upgrade)

With this new design, all players will be rewarded each month with crystals they can use to purchase items in the VIP shop in addition to any crystals you earn through achievements.

notes.title: Bonus Offer: 25 FREE Crystonian Crystals
notes.content:
Every player who purchases the game now starts off with 25 FREE Crystonian Crystals that can be used in our VIP Shop. This will guarantee enough crystals for VIP Access plus any Minor resource Pack for every new player who joins the game. 

*The crystals can be spent on anything in the shop if you choose VIP Access or not.

This offer is for all players and should make the game more accessible and fair being that VIP Access no longer has to be earned or purchased.

If you purchased the game before this update was made, just contact me in game or post in our discussion board and we'll add 25 crystals to your account.

notes.title: New Rules Concerning Crystonian Crystal Purchases
notes.content: To keep the game fair and balanced, each crystonian crystal package can only be purchased once a month. Any further crystals MUST be earned in game. You can purchase all 3 packages anytime during the month but once you've purchased one of them, you can not repeat the same purchase for that package.
